stories.headline: Merz conducts first China visit as Chancellor, meets Xi Jinping amid trade tensions
stories.summary: Chancellor Friedrich Merz completed his inaugural visit to China on February 24-26, meeting with President Xi Jinping and Premier Li Qiang. Merz criticized Germany's trade deficit with China as 'unhealthy' while announcing an Airbus deal and seeking Chinese influence to end the Ukraine war.

articles.title: Hoppla: Warum klingt Friedrich Merz in China plötzlich so anders?
Friedrich Merz in China: Kanzler Merz kritisiert Handelsdefizit mit China als "nicht gesund"
Merz calls for rebalancing of Germany's 'unhealthy' trade ties with China

stories.headline: Court blocks intelligence service from classifying AfD as 'secured right-wing extremist'
stories.summary: The Cologne Administrative Court ruled on February 26 that the Federal Office for the Protection of the Constitution cannot classify the AfD as 'secured right-wing extremist' pending a full hearing. The court found insufficient evidence despite acknowledging 'strong suspicion' of anti-constitutional activities.

articles.title: AfD vorerst nicht als gesichert rechtsextremistisch eingestuft – Weidel spricht von „großem Sieg"

stories.headline: AfD faces nepotism scandal over crossover employment of relatives
stories.summary: The AfD is embroiled in a growing scandal over 'Vetternwirtschaft' (cronyism), with multiple cases revealed of party members employing relatives of other AfD politicians in their offices. The Bundestag held a debate on February 26, with calls for resignations and internal party investigations.

articles.title: Aktuelle Stunde zur AfD-Verwandtenaffäre: Eine Partei in der Defensive
Beschäftigung Angehöriger: AfD fordert Abgeordnete Martina Uhr zur Niederlegung ihres Mandats auf

stories.headline: Presidential election date set for January 30, 2027 as Steinmeier palace renovation costs revealed
stories.summary: Bundestag President Julia Klöckner announced that Steinmeier's successor will be elected on January 30, 2027. Separately, it was revealed that renovating Bellevue Palace will cost over 601 million euros and take 8 years, meaning the next president will spend their entire term in temporary quarters.

articles.title: Steinmeier-Nachfolge: Wahltermin für Bundespräsidenten steht fest
Sanierung von Bellevue soll mindestens 601 Millionen kosten

stories.headline: Iran crisis response: Wadephul rules out evacuation of stranded Germans from Middle East
stories.summary: Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul said Germany cannot evacuate stranded Germans from the Middle East due to closed airspace following Iran-US-Israel military confrontation. The Foreign Office issued strong travel warnings and Wadephul criticized Iran's regime as terroristic.

articles.title: Krieg in Nahost: Johann Wadephul schließt Rückholung deutscher Staatsbürger aus

stories.headline: Bundestag committee approves Kamikaze drone procurement despite Peter Thiel concerns
stories.summary: The Bundestag budget committee approved purchasing Kamikaze drones for 540 million euros from German firms Helsing and Stark Defence on February 25. The decision faced criticism due to Trump associate Peter Thiel's investment in Stark Defence, with additional oversight requirements imposed.

stories.headline: Pistorius criticizes Trump's relationship with Putin on Ukraine war anniversary
stories.summary: Defense Minister Boris Pistorius accused US President Trump of 'buddy-like' behavior with Putin around the fourth anniversary of Russia's invasion of Ukraine on February 24. Pistorius warned that Trump's approach undermines Ukraine support and NATO solidarity.

articles.title: Pistorius wirft Trump "Kumpanei" mit Putin vor
Ukraine-Krieg - Pistorius rügt Nähe Trumps zu Putin

stories.headline: CDU party congress in Stuttgart approves social media age limits and other policies
stories.summary: The CDU held its federal party congress in Stuttgart on February 20-21, approving a minimum age of 14 for social media platforms, rejecting a sugar tax proposal, and making various other policy decisions. Merz received 91.17% support in leadership vote.

articles.title: Internet: Kommt eine Social-Media-Altersgrenze ab 14 Jahren?

stories.headline: Merz meets Trump in Washington amid tensions over tariffs and Ukraine
stories.summary: Chancellor Friedrich Merz met with US President Donald Trump in Washington on March 2 for their second meeting since Merz took office. The meeting focused on Trump's tariff threats against Europe and Ukraine policy, with Merz seeking clarity on US positions.

articles.title: Merz fliegt zu Trump – Bundesregierung erwartet „Klarheit" bei Zöllen
Merz am Dienstag bei Trump im Weißen Haus

stories.headline: Klingbeil announces action plan against organized crime with new powers for authorities
stories.summary: Finance Minister Lars Klingbeil, along with Interior Minister Dobrindt and Justice Minister Hubig, announced a new action plan against organized crime on February 25. The plan includes enhanced cooperation between customs and BKA, new digital powers, and easier asset seizure from criminal organizations.

articles.title: Organisierte Kriminalität: Wie Klingbeil und Dobrindt an die Villen und Luxusautos der Clanchefs wollen
Bundesregierung will Organisierte Kriminalität effektiver bekämpfen

stories.headline: Bundeswehr recruitment of minors reaches record high with over 3,000 17-year-olds
stories.summary: The Bundeswehr recruited 3,131 minors in 2025, the highest number since data collection began in 2011. Opposition politicians criticized the practice while the defense ministry defends recruiting 17-year-olds with parental consent to address personnel shortages.

articles.title: Bundeswehr: Mehr als 3.000 Minderjährige 2025 eingestellt
Bundeswehr: Zahl minderjähriger Soldaten steigt auf Rekordwert

stories.headline: Baden-Württemberg CDU candidate Hagel faces criticism over old sexist comments
stories.summary: CDU lead candidate Manuel Hagel for Baden-Württemberg's March 8 state election faced criticism after an old 2018 video surfaced showing him making inappropriate comments about a female student. The controversy emerged as polls show the race tightening between CDU and Greens.
